site: Apollo 15 — Hadley Rille and the Apennine Front
citation: NASA LRO LOLA + JAXA Kaguya TC merged DEM, 512 ppd (~59 m/px)
grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 121 deg
resolution_note: source product is 59.225 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 69 x 35 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
note: The first rover traverse, up the Apennine Front. Slope walking beside a 300 m sinuous rille.
